choice-justified:directed-handoff-flow.why: The question is about routing (which source goes where, which store, where they meet). A two-lane flow puts the routing on the page as edges; a mis-placed or missing piece shows as a wrong or missing arrow.

rejected:project-schedule.why: Router's top score, but the plan has no dates or durations; a Gantt would invent a time axis and hide the two-store convergence.

rejected:state-machine-view.why: State is one attribute per node (done/running/not started), not transitions; carried as a badge instead.

rejected:staged-explanatory-machine.why: Scroll-staged reveal breaks whole-on-one-screen and the under-a-minute read.

rejected:prose-or-table.why: Brian asked for a picture; a list cannot show the convergence on the register.
